2023-04-23
The claimant reported a sideswipe while changing lanes and descrbied a sharp neck jolt along with immediate
stiffness. Photos taken at the scene show damage consistent with the described impact, and the vehicle's damage
pattern matches the account given.
2023-04-28
A review of the policy confirms the driver is named on it and that coverage was in force at the time of the loss.
Nothing in the file suggests the vehicle was damaged before coverage began, and no earlier damage to the vehicle is
known.
2023-05-18
The police report and statements from the scene confirm the claimant was in the vehicle at the time. No independent
witnesses have come forward, so the scene photos are the main independent record of the event.
2023-06-17
The claimant was contacted by phone and gave the same account of the collision as in the initial report. Details of the
lane change and the point of contact did not shift between conversations.
2023-07-07
Medical records show whiplash diagnosed shortly after the collision, which fits the kind and force of the crash. No
earlier injury to the same area of the neck or upper back is known from the claimant's history or prior claims search.
2023-08-04
Treatment followed a typical course of physiotherapy and medication, and the reported symptoms eased steadily as
the patient improved. Records from the most recent visit show the treatment has tapered off.
2023-09-19
Based on the photos, the damage, the police confirmation, the consistent account, and the medical course, the file
spuports the claim as presented. Next step is to finalize the injury settlement review with the treating provider's fnial
report.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
